verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Grok Build accepting an API key (for example an env var or config key) in place of account login. The only documented auth path is account-based device-code login via `--device-auth`. Community reports describe access gated on SuperGrok subscription login, with one user stuck at the login prompt and another using xAI OAuth. The xAI API availability of grok-4.7 is presented for use in your own agent loop, not as a way to authenticate Grok Build.
